name: Okta — Victim Successful Login From External IP (Post-Phishing)
xql_query:
dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter eventType = "user.session.start" or eventType = "user.authentication.sso"
| alter outcome_result = arrayindex(regextract(outcome, "\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        ip = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"ipAddress\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        user_name = arrayindex(regextract(actor, "\"alternateId\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter outcome_result = "SUCCESS" and ip != null and user_name != null
| filter not (user_name contains "svc-" or user_name contains "api-" or user_name contains "default.user")
| fields user_name, ip, _time as login_time
| join type = inner (
    dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
    | filter senderIP != null
    | fields senderIP, recipient, sender, subject, _log_type as mail_event, _time as mail_time) as pp
  pp.senderIP = ip
| filter recipient contains user_name
     and mail_time <= login_time
     and timestamp_diff(login_time, mail_time, "HOUR") <= 24
| comp count() as logins, min(login_time) as first_login, min(mail_time) as first_mail,
       values(sender) as mail_senders, values(subject) as subjects, values(mail_event) as mail_events
  by user_name, ip
| alter attacker_ip = ip
| fields user_name, attacker_ip, logins, first_login, first_mail, mail_senders, subjects, mail_events
description: Okta sign-in SUCCESS for a user from the same IP that sent that user mail (Proofpoint senderIP) in the previous 24 hours: the phisher using harvested credentials.
alert_name: Okta — Victim Successful Login From External IP (Post-Phishing)
alert_description:
Okta sign-in SUCCESS for a user from the same IP that sent that user mail (Proofpoint senderIP) in the previous 24 hours: the phisher using harvested credentials.

Investigate: the mail_senders/subjects that came from attacker_ip, whether the user clicked, and everything the session did after first_login.
